displayName: inflect disk filling — act before postgres cannot write

conditions.displayName: disk reporting stopped — absence is not health

documentation.content:
Root filesystem on the inflect-compliance VM is above threshold.

WHY THIS EXISTS: on 2026-09-24 the disk reached 100%, postgres could not write WAL, crashed mid-write and crash-looped eight times. Every crash took /api/readyz down, so the first signal of a full disk was a database already failing. 14GB of it was container images orphaned by two historical registry renames — WATCHTOWER_CLEANUP only prunes the image path it currently manages.

FIRST CHECKS:
  docker system df            (reclaimable is usually the answer)
  docker images               (look for images on dead registry paths)
  sudo du -xh --max-depth=1 / | sort -rh | head

The 85% warn threshold leaves roughly 7GB on a 49GB disk — enough to act deliberately rather than under a crashed database.
